title: Research CV
audience: Research supervisors, labs and academic collaborators
headline: Research Interests: Reliable Machine Learning · Health Informatics
summary: First Class Computer Science graduate interested in the reliability, transferability and practical interpretation of machine-learning systems. Current work examines validation design and label comparability for maternal risk classification across public datasets.

research.title: Validation reliability and transferability of maternal risk classification across two public datasets
research.organization: Manuscript in preparation; independent verification ongoing
research.details: Examines profile-grouped validation, repeated predictors, source-label provenance, and limited cross-dataset label agreement; currently under methodological revision.

projects.title: FraudLens
projects.details: Experimental evaluation under extreme class imbalance with held-out testing and documented metrics.

projects.title: StudentPath
projects.details: Studied availability-aware prediction stages and trade-offs between early prediction and information access.

additional: Research interests: predictive-model evaluation, dataset shift, health informatics, responsible AI.
